'''Kettius''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] who led the [[Kettius Expedition]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in an ill-fated effort to conduct geological surveys of the ice-covered world. Doctor Kettius perished along with the expedition.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Archaeology|A Chilling Discovery}}</ref>
